Rob Reiner's Son Nick Reiner: I Lived on the Streets Battling Drug Addiction Thursday May 16, 2024 Image (People, April 20) Nick Reiner, the son of filmmaker Rob Reiner, co-wrote a film loosely based on his drug addiction experience. 22-year-old Nick, who first went to rehab at age 15, has been working on staying clean since he left at 19. He recalls spending a lot of time homeless, sleeping on the streets. Being Charlie is a film he wrote based on his experience in rehab, and the stories he heard from other addicts about their experiences. The preview is available on the article page. READ MORE.
